variants.text: A young woman with an oval face, almond-shaped eyes, and a straight nose.
Young woman with an oval face, rounded hairline, soft-arched eyebrows, almond-shaped eyes, and a straight nose with a rounded tip.

Young adult woman with an oval face shape. Features a rounded hairline with moderate temporal recession, medium-thick soft-arched eyebrows with lateral thinning, almond-shaped eyes with double upper-lid creases, a straight nasal dorsum with a rounded tip, and a medium-width mouth with a defined cupid's bow. Skin is smooth without prominent marks.

This is a young woman with an oval-shaped face and smooth skin. She has almond-shaped eyes, arched eyebrows that are thinner toward the outer edges, and a straight nose with a rounded tip. Her mouth has a well-defined cupid's bow and she is showing her upper teeth in a wide smile.
